processingEngine.title: Processing Engine
processingEngine.description: Processing Engine Configuration. If not provided, the Native Engine will be used by default.

oneOf.title: Native Engine Configuration
oneOf.description: Configuration for the native metadata ingestion engine

type.description: The type of the engine configuration

oneOf.title: Spark Engine Configuration
oneOf.description: This schema defines the configuration for a Spark Engine runner.

tempPath.description: Temporary path to store the data.

extraConfig.title: Additional Spark Configuration
extraConfig.description: Additional Spark configuration properties as key-value pairs.

classificationFilterPattern.description: Regex to only compute metrics for table that matches the given tag, tiers, gloassary pattern.
classificationFilterPattern.title: Classification Filter Pattern

schemaFilterPattern.description: Regex to only fetch tables or databases that matches the pattern.
schemaFilterPattern.title: Schema Filter Pattern

tableFilterPattern.description: Regex exclude tables or databases that matches the pattern.
tableFilterPattern.title: Table Filter Pattern

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

databaseFilterPattern.description: Regex to only fetch databases that matches the pattern.
databaseFilterPattern.title: Database Filter Pattern

includeViews.description: Optional configuration to turn off fetching metadata for views.
includeViews.title: Include Views

useFqnForFiltering.description: Regex will be applied on fully qualified name (e.g service_name.db_name.schema_name.table_name) instead of raw name (e.g. table_name)
useFqnForFiltering.title: Use FQN For Filtering

computeTableMetrics.description: Option to turn on/off table metric computation. If enabled, profiler will compute table level metrics.
computeTableMetrics.title: Compute Table Metrics

computeColumnMetrics.description: Option to turn on/off column metric computation. If enabled, profiler will compute column level metrics.
computeColumnMetrics.title: Compute Column Metrics

useStatistics.description: Use system tables to extract table metrics. Metrics that cannot be gathered from system tables will use the default methods. Using system tables can be faster but requires gathering statistics before running (for example using the ANALYZE procedure). More information can be found in the documentation: https://docs.openmetadata.org/latest/profler
useStatistics.title: Use System Table Statistics

profileSampleConfig.title: Profile Sample Config
profileSampleConfig.description: Profile sample configuration supporting static and dynamic sampling strategies.

sampleConfigType.title: Sample Config Type
sampleConfigType.description: Type of sampling to apply. STATIC: fixed sample size. DYNAMIC: sample size determined at runtime based on row count thresholds.

oneOf.title: DynamicSamplingConfig
oneOf.description: Configuration for dynamic sampling based on table row count.

smartSampling.description: Set to true to dynamically determine sampling percentage based on row count thresholds. If false, the thresholds values passed will be used as the sampling configuration.
smartSampling.title: Smart Sampling

thresholds.description: Row count thresholds for sampling. Evaluated in order from highest to lowest threshold. Tables below the lowest threshold are profiled at 100% (no sampling).

rowCountThreshold.description: Minimum row count for this tier to apply
rowCountThreshold.title: Row Count Threshold

profileSample.description: Sample percentage or row count to use for tables at or above this threshold
profileSample.title: Profile Sample

oneOf.title: StaticSamplingConfig
oneOf.description: Configuration for static sampling based on table row count.

profileSample.description: Percentage of data or no. of rows used to compute the profiler metrics and run data quality tests
profileSample.title: Profile Sample

profileSampleType.title: Profile Sample Type
profileSampleType.description: Type of Profile Sample (percentage or rows)

samplingMethodType.title: Sampling Method Type
samplingMethodType.description: Type of Sampling Method (BERNOULLI or SYSTEM)

randomizedSample.description: Whether to randomize the sample data or not.

threadCount.description: Number of threads to use during metric computations
threadCount.title: Thread Count

metrics.description: List of metrics to compute. If empty, then all metrics will be computed

items.description: This schema defines all possible metric types in OpenMetadata.
